title: ECP Registration Package (M3-RG0 — submission to the Registration Authority)
description: The package submitted to the Registration Authority for acceptance into the protected registration boundary (M3-RG0, 0.7.0, order §4). It embeds the full public case document, the sealed ground-truth commitment (never the ground-truth content — the protected store keeps custody), the frozen success-criterion copy, the evaluation environment, the provenance lineage references, and the six Owner-bound ruling citations in force at submission. The authority validates the schema, recomputes every cryptographic commitment (case, criterion, environment, provenance, package self-hash), verifies the ground-truth seam, checks the ruling citations against the authoritative gate, enforces duplicate control, assigns the deterministic registration identity and establishes the immutable registration record — or REFUSES (fail-closed) before any authoritative write. package_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with package_hash removed. Public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real submission material (private trust area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

case_document.description: The full PUBLIC case document (validated against the 'case' contract by the authority; carries its own ground_truth_reference.commitment).

store_reference.description: Optional pointer to the protected store that holds the sealed ground truth (custody side of the seam).

success_criterion.description: Frozen copy of the case document's success criterion (the case contract pins it as a non-empty string; object form reserved for richer criterion contracts); the authority verifies byte-equality with case_document.success_criterion (criterion tampering detection).

pins.description: Pinned environment facts (tool versions, system pins, harness parameters) — part of the environment commitment.

owner_ruling_citations.description: The six rulings cited in force at submission; the authority verifies they match the authoritative gate citations exactly (divergence = REFUSED, never merged).
